_meta.description: JoyIT Staffing — Employer Compliance Data by Country
_meta.update_instructions: Edit this file and commit to gh-pages branch. The app auto-loads it on page load.

fields.name: Country display name with flag emoji
fields.risk: Compliance risk level: Low / Medium / High / Very High
fields.official_url: Official government / labour ministry URL for verification

IN.name: 🇮🇳 India
IN.law: EPF Act 1952 · ESI Act 1948 · Payment of Gratuity Act
IN.td: EPF 12% + ESI 3.25% on basic · Gratuity after 5 yrs service
IN.hd: ESI covers employees earning under Rs21k/mo · Group medical optional

US.name: 🇺🇸 USA
US.law: FLSA · FMLA · ERISA · ACA · State laws vary
US.td: FICA: SS 6.2% + Medicare 1.45% · FUTA max 6% · State SUI varies
US.hd: ACA mandate >50 FTEs · Avg $700-1500/mo employer cost

GB.name: 🇬🇧 UK
GB.law: Employment Rights Act 1996 · Working Time Regs 1998 · NMW Act
GB.hd: NHS funded via NI · Private health at employer discretion

SG.name: 🇸🇬 Singapore
SG.law: Employment Act Cap.91 · CPF Act · Child Dev Co-Savings Act
SG.td: CPF 17% up to S$1,530/mo · SDL 0.25% · FWL for foreign workers
SG.hd: CPF includes Medisave · Employer may top up with private plan

AE.name: 🇦🇪 UAE
AE.law: UAE Labour Law Decree No.33/2021 · DIFC Employment Law
AE.td: 0% employer tax for expats · Emiratisation levy if over quota
AE.hd: Mandatory health insurance all employees in Dubai & Abu Dhabi

AU.name: 🇦🇺 Australia
AU.law: Fair Work Act 2009 · NES · Superannuation Guarantee Act
AU.td: Super 11.5% (rising to 12% in 2025) · State payroll tax varies
AU.hd: Medicare universal · Private health top-up optional

DE.name: 🇩🇪 Germany
DE.hd: Statutory health mandatory · Private (PKV) for high earners

FR.name: 🇫🇷 France
FR.law: Code du Travail · CCN Collective Agreements · Labour Reform
FR.td: Total employer charges ~42% of gross salary via URSSAF
FR.hd: Assurance Maladie ~70% · Mutuelle supplemental often employer-paid

CA.name: 🇨🇦 Canada
CA.law: Canada Labour Code · ESA (provincial) · CPP/EI Act
CA.td: CPP 5.95% + EI 1.66% · Provincial payroll taxes vary
CA.hd: Universal provincial healthcare · Employers add dental/drug/vision

MY.name: 🇲🇾 Malaysia
MY.law: Employment Act 1955 · EPF Act 1991 · SOCSO Act 1969
MY.hd: Panel clinic coverage common · No statutory health beyond SOCSO

PH.name: 🇵🇭 Philippines
PH.law: Labor Code PH · SSS Law · PhilHealth Act · Pag-IBIG Fund Act
PH.hd: PhilHealth mandatory · HMO supplemental common in BPO/IT

ID.name: 🇮🇩 Indonesia
ID.law: Manpower Law 13/2003 · Job Creation Law · BPJS Regulations
ID.hd: BPJS Kesehatan mandatory · Employer pays 4% of salary

JP.name: 🇯🇵 Japan
JP.law: Labor Standards Act · Health Insurance Act · Pension Insurance Act
JP.hd: Shakai Hoken mandatory for all full-time employees

NL.name: 🇳🇱 Netherlands
NL.hd: ZVW 6.57% mandatory · Employer pays zorgtoeslag to employees

SA.name: 🇸🇦 Saudi Arabia
SA.law: Saudi Labor Law Decree M/51 · GOSI Regulations · Nitaqat
SA.td: GOSI: Expats 2% · Saudis 11.75% · Saudization quota penalties
SA.hd: Cooperative Health Insurance mandatory for all employees

ZA.name: 🇿🇦 South Africa
ZA.td: SDL 1% + UIF 1% = 2% total · PAYE employer withholding
ZA.hd: No statutory health mandate · Medical aid contributions voluntary

BR.name: 🇧🇷 Brazil
BR.hd: Plano de saude not mandated but widely expected for retention

MX.name: 🇲🇽 Mexico
MX.law: Ley Federal del Trabajo · IMSS Law · SAR Pension Law
MX.hd: IMSS mandatory health · Supplemental private plans common

NZ.name: 🇳🇿 New Zealand
NZ.law: Employment Relations Act 2000 · Holidays Act 2003 · KiwiSaver Act
NZ.td: KiwiSaver 3% employer + ACC levy ~1.2% · No payroll tax
NZ.hd: ACC covers workplace injury · Public health via taxation

KE.name: 🇰🇪 Kenya
KE.law: Employment Act 2007 · NSSF Act 2013 · NHIF Act
KE.td: NSSF KES200/mo + NHIF KES1700/mo · PAYE employer responsibility
KE.hd: NHIF mandatory · Employers commonly top up with private cover
